// diagnostic R0803

Jet.MisalignedRawAccess

misaligned raw `{operation}` in `{gate}`

What

misaligned raw `{operation}` in `{gate}`

Why

This raw `{operation}` needs an aligned pointer, but {detail}.

Fix

Derive an aligned pointer from the live allocation, or use the typed memory operation instead of raw address arithmetic — obligation `{obligation}` was not met on this run.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.MisalignedRawAccess: Tests/UI/runtime_r0803.stderr.

Error: Jet.MisalignedRawAccess: misaligned raw `read` in `the read starts one byte into a live Int`
  --> runtime_r0803.jet:9:15, in #Unsafe gate "the read starts one byte into a live Int"
 Why: This raw `read` needs an aligned pointer, but the address is a multiple of 8 plus 1, so it is not aligned to 8 bytes.
 Fix: Derive an aligned pointer from the live allocation, or use the typed memory operation instead of raw address arithmetic — obligation `valid_ptr` was not met on this run.
obligation: valid_ptr = false
exit: 70
